name: signing-v1
about: Signed messages v1, contracts/relay-api.md 'Signed messages'. Made by scripts/gen_signing_vectors.py; do not edit by hand. Seeds are public TEST keys. Python (workspace), Rust (relay) and Swift (phone) run every section; Swift skips 'sign' (CryptoKit signatures are randomized).

ws_a.fingerprint: H1Z2 NVRZ 562G ANC2 C7SG CZBD CCGC R7VC

ws_c.fingerprint: 37WZ TWJA RKZ0 9HYW SAWR K8B4 SERB PR8F

messages.name: good_text
messages.note: A signed text from ws_a to ws_b.

messages.name: good_with_relay_meta
messages.note: relay_meta is outside the signature and never read by decisions.

messages.name: good_file
messages.note: A file listed by blob id, size and hash.

messages.name: good_answer
messages.note: An answer names the question's hash.

messages.name: good_allow
messages.note: An allow carries expires_ms, at most 60 minutes after created_ms.

messages.name: good_to_phones
messages.note: A workspace text to every phone; the phone checks it.

messages.name: good_from_phone
messages.note: The phone signs the same format, always as a person.

messages.name: good_group
messages.note: To a group: host, group id and member-list version are signed.

messages.name: good_escapes
messages.note: Escapes and non-ASCII text are fine when well formed.

messages.name: good_whitespace_inside
messages.note: Whitespace between tokens is allowed (only outside the object it is not).

messages.name: future_within_skew
messages.note: Created 4 minutes ahead of the receiver's clock: allowed.

messages.name: text_29_days_old
messages.note: Text up to 30 days old is still taken.

messages.name: wrong_key
messages.note: Signed by another key but naming ws_a's key id.

messages.name: wrong_key_unknown_id
messages.note: Signed by a key nobody accepted or registered.

messages.name: wrong_purpose
messages.note: Signed as a problem report, presented as a message.

messages.name: wrong_no_tag
messages.note: Signed over the bare bytes without the orch-sig-v1 tag.

messages.name: wrong_sender
messages.note: Valid signature by ws_a, but the signed from says ws_c.

messages.name: wrong_small_order_key
messages.note: The neutral point as a key with R = neutral, S = 0 'verifies' any text in a careless library; the key is refused.

messages.name: missing_sig
messages.note: Envelope without a signature.

messages.name: missing_sig_empty
messages.note: Empty signature.

messages.name: missing_envelope
messages.note: A plain unsigned message (no envelope at all).

messages.name: changed_body
messages.note: One word of the signed bytes changed after signing.

messages.name: changed_signature
messages.note: One bit of the signature flipped.

messages.name: changed_malleable_s
messages.note: S + L (same math, second spelling): refused.

messages.name: replayed
messages.note: The same message again: the receiver refuses a seen id; the relay answers duplicate.

messages.name: replayed_other_bytes
messages.note: A seen id with other signed bytes: refused by both (relay 409 conflict).

messages.name: replayed_expired_allow
messages.note: An allow released after it expired.

messages.name: replayed_old_text
messages.note: A text held back 31 days.

messages.name: future
messages.note: Created 6 minutes ahead of the receiver's clock.

messages.name: redirected
messages.note: Signed for ws_c, delivered to ws_b.

messages.name: redirected_phone_text_to_other_phone
messages.note: Signed for one phone, delivered to another.

messages.name: redirected_group_not_member
messages.note: A group message to a workspace not in that group.

messages.name: from_self
messages.note: Our own message handed back to us.

messages.name: strict_dup_key_escaped
messages.note: Correctly signed, but the bytes break a strict reading rule.

messages.name: strict_bom
messages.note: Correctly signed, but the bytes break a strict reading rule.

messages.name: strict_trailing_newline
messages.note: Correctly signed, but the bytes break a strict reading rule.

messages.name: strict_float
messages.note: Correctly signed, but the bytes break a strict reading rule.

messages.name: strict_int_above_2_53
messages.note: Correctly signed, but the bytes break a strict reading rule.

messages.name: strict_lone_high_surrogate
messages.note: Correctly signed, but the bytes break a strict reading rule.

messages.name: strict_invalid_utf8
messages.note: Correctly signed, but the bytes break a strict reading rule.

messages.name: strict_too_deep
messages.note: Correctly signed, but the bytes break a strict reading rule.

messages.name: field_unknown_top_field
messages.note: An unknown field is refused, never ignored.

messages.name: field_missing_origin
messages.note: origin is required.

messages.name: field_bool_as_version
messages.note: true is not the integer 1.

messages.name: field_created_as_string
messages.note: Times are integer milliseconds.

messages.name: field_allow_without_expiry
messages.note: allow, delegate and start need expires_ms.

messages.name: field_expiry_over_60_min
messages.note: expires_ms at most 60 minutes after created_ms.

messages.name: field_expiry_on_text
messages.note: expires_ms only on allow, delegate and start.

messages.name: field_answer_without_question_hash
messages.note: An answer must sign the question's hash.

messages.name: field_to_equals_from
messages.note: A message to itself.

messages.name: field_file_without_files
messages.note: A file message lists its files.

messages.name: field_file_bad_hash
messages.note: A file hash is 64 lowercase hex characters.

messages.name: field_file_extra_field
messages.note: File entries have exactly blob_id, size, sha256.

messages.name: field_type_from_relay_list
messages.note: Types the relay makes itself are never signed messages.

messages.name: field_phone_as_helper
messages.note: A phone signs only as a person.

messages.name: field_phone_to_phones
messages.note: A phone sends only to a workspace.

messages.name: field_ticket_trailing_newline
messages.note: A trailing newline is not part of an id pattern.

messages.name: field_id_trailing_newline
messages.note: A trailing newline is not part of an id pattern.

messages.name: field_question_id_on_text
messages.note: question_id only on an answer.

messages.name: field_group_allow
messages.note: A group message is never an allow.

messages.name: field_group_start
messages.note: A group message is never a start.

messages.name: field_group_answer
messages.note: A group message is never an answer.

messages.name: strict_dup_key_other_unicode_spelling
messages.note: Two keys that are the same text in another Unicode spelling (NFC) count as a duplicate.

messages.name: same_key_two_contacts
messages.note: One key listed under two contacts: the signed from decides, never the order of the list.

messages.name: future_exactly_5_min
messages.note: Exactly 5 minutes ahead is still allowed.

messages.name: expired_exactly_at_expiry
messages.note: At expires_ms the allow is expired.

messages.name: text_exactly_30_days_old
messages.note: Exactly 30 days old is still taken (older is refused).

messages.name: envelope_padded_base64
messages.note: base64url without padding only.

messages.name: envelope_standard_base64_chars
messages.note: + and / are not base64url.

messages.name: envelope_noncanonical_base64_bits
messages.note: Unused trailing bits must be zero (one spelling only).

messages.name: envelope_key_id_uppercase
messages.note: key_id is 16 lowercase hex characters.

messages.name: envelope_sig_63_bytes
messages.note: A signature is exactly 64 bytes.

messages.name: envelope_sig_65_bytes
messages.note: A signature is exactly 64 bytes.

messages.name: envelope_unknown_field
messages.note: Unknown envelope fields are refused.

messages.name: envelope_sig_v_2
messages.note: Only sig_v 1 exists.

messages.name: envelope_relay_meta_not_object
messages.note: relay_meta is an object when present.

messages.name: envelope_signed_empty
messages.note: The signed bytes are not empty.

messages.name: envelope_sig_v_float
messages.note: sig_v is the integer 1, not 1.0.
